description: Returns what a page holds, measured from what is drawn: each room with its floor area and perimeter, each wall with its length, doors and windows by size, floors and walls by material, and objects placed. Areas are in m², lengths in m, volumes in m³, thicknesses and the sizes of doors and windows in mm. A room whose walls do not close has an area of 0.

of.description: Which parts to return. Leave it out for all of them.

page.description: Id of a page or component. Leave it out for the one being worked on.

name: measure_drawing
